#212 correctness review, round 2: PASS

Exact head: `8024824250b6caae856a09a18fca95039f173ce0`. Final round under C34, scoped to the delta from `68ecd898a068ac4420b0defb2fd7445f7ccffafd`. Both round-1 findings close; no remaining normal-use correctness blocker found in this delta.

- **F001 closed.** `crates/core/src/turn_end.rs:143-176` tracks enclosing backtick/tilde fences from the start, requires the last eligible block to close and permits only whitespace afterward. The four-line text-fence counterexample is content, not commands. `.omp/extensions/pij/core/turn-end.ts:109-140,180-210` uses the corresponding fence-state scan for display. Tests retain indented/final-block behavior and cover quoted examples, longer outer fences and a real block following a quote.
- **F002 closed.** `crates/daemon/src/http/turn_end.rs:197-249` applies pure send rules during the all-lines preflight, before dispatch. Role-address/role-only checks share `http/role_send.rs:73-107`; force/reason checks share `http/cold_wake.rs:202-214`; option values use the same reply/duration parsers as delivery, and attachment resolution reuses the shim helper. `crates/daemon/tests/turn_end_http.rs:303-355` exercises nine argument-invalid sends after a valid FYI, checks no FYI was held and includes a positive control that observes one held FYI. Dispatch still uses the existing handlers, with sequential refusal and ran/refused/not_run reporting preserved. The stricter reason requirement for a role send that would only queue is explicitly documented in Known limits.

The other repairs use `caller_text`/`fenced` for echoed commands and reasons, clip OMP transport reasons, and add bounded renderer caches. Cost: no added launch or periodic activity in this delta; renderer work is per draw, with full scans for new texts containing an opener and a 32-entry cache per streaming state. The existing result-display idle wait remains 50 ms, at most 40 ticks per block. Streaming scan cost and replay non-idempotency remain documented limits; this is not an independent live-fleet performance measurement.

**Evidence:** `just pr-freeze 212` returned FINAL at this head; detached review tree clean. [CI run 42738518665](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42738518665) records this exact head and passed all checks. The successful Rust job's [JUnit artifact 13727009911](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42738518665/artifacts/13727009911) contains 2,366 executed tests with no failures/errors; nextest reports six additional skips. All 11 core turn-end and seven turn-end HTTP tests are present and passed, including both repairs and the escaped-echo regression. Node 22 CI passed the 15 pure turn-end, six OMP-adapter and 37 link-global tests (overall 2,281 passed, six skipped). Source review plus CI evidence; no local builds/tests, mutations, live writes or reviewer-run pane exercises.
